name: BOB Beauty Modelling Eyeliner Pen Black 1.2g
description:
BOB Modelling Eyeliner Pen Black 1.2g

Description:
Achieve precise and striking eye looks with the BOB Waterproof Pencil Eyeliner in classic black. Designed for long-lasting wear, this eyeliner defines and enhances your eyes while staying smudge-proof throughout the day.

Key Features:

Waterproof Formula: Resistant to sweat, tears, and humidity.

Long-Lasting & Smudge-Proof: Keeps your eye makeup flawless all day.

Easy Application: Smooth tip allows precise lining and effortless use.

Versatile: Perfect for everyday wear or creating bold, dramatic eye looks.

Category: Health & Beauty

A must-have essential for any makeup collection, ensuring bold, defined, and captivating eyes.
